<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include">

        <script><![CDATA[/* Script Include: name SourcingEngine, API name x_2056099_indust_0.SourcingEngine, Accessible from: All application scopes. Edit __SC_CONFIG to change settings and supplier lead times. */
var __SC_CONFIG = {
 "settings": {
  "safetyFirst": true,
  "allowSplit": true,
  "transitBuffer": 0.5,
  "preemptBuffer": 1,
  "priorityGap": 1,
  "allowCriticalPreempt": false,
  "approvalValue": 100000
 },
 "supplierLeadDays": {
  "ABC Metals Pvt Ltd": {
   "WH-BLR": 3,
   "WH-HYD": 6,
   "WH-MAA": 5
  },
  "Sri Venkateswara Alloys": {
   "WH-HYD": 3,
   "WH-BLR": 6,
   "WH-MAA": 7
  },
  "Chennai Fasteners and Seals": {
   "WH-MAA": 2,
   "WH-BLR": 4,
   "WH-HYD": 7
  },
  "Deccan Electricals Pvt Ltd": {
   "WH-HYD": 4,
   "WH-BLR": 7,
   "WH-MAA": 8
  },
  "Kaveri Packaging Works": {
   "WH-BLR": 2,
   "WH-MAA": 4,
   "WH-HYD": 5
  },
  "SCN Supplier A": {
   "WH-BLR": 10,
   "WH-HYD": 5,
   "WH-MAA": 12
  },
  "SCN Supplier B": {
   "WH-BLR": 4,
   "WH-HYD": 6,
   "WH-MAA": 6
  },
  "SCN Supplier C": {
   "WH-BLR": 12,
   "WH-HYD": 5,
   "WH-MAA": 12
  }
 }
};
function __SC_factory() {
  var DEFAULTS = { safetyFirst: true, allowSplit: true, transitBuffer: 0.5, preemptBuffer: 1, priorityGap: 1, allowCriticalPreempt: false, approvalValue: 100000 };
  function n(x) { return Number(x) || 0; }
  function merge(a, b) { var o = {}, k; for (k in a) o[k] = a[k]; for (k in (b || {})) o[k] = b[k]; return o; }
  function byEta(a, b) { return a.eta - b.eta; }
  function has(x) { return x !== null && x !== undefined; }
  function plan(db, p, cfgIn) {
    var cfg = merge(DEFAULTS, cfgIn), log = [], lines = [], refill = null, failed = false, i, j;
    var M = p.material, D = p.destination, need = n(p.neededByDays), prio = p.priority || 2, rem = n(p.qty);
    var mat = db.material(M) || { critical: false, cost: 0 }, cost = n(mat.cost);
    function say(s) { log.push(s); }
    function transit(a, b) { var o = p.transferOverride && p.transferOverride[a + '>' + b]; return has(o) ? o : db.transfer(a, b); }
    function take(av) { av = Math.max(0, av); if (rem <= 0 || av <= 0) return 0; if (cfg.allowSplit) return Math.min(av, rem); return av >= rem ? rem : 0; }
    function add(l) { l.cost = n(l.qty) * cost; if (l.late === undefined) l.late = l.eta > need; lines.push(l); rem -= l.qty; }
    var wh = db.locations();
    var own = db.stock(M, D), free = Math.max(0, own.avail - own.safety);
    say('Step 1 local ' + D + ': good-batch available ' + own.avail + ', safety ' + own.safety + ', free above safety ' + free + ', need ' + rem);
    var t = take(free);
    if (t > 0) add({ step: 'Local Available', from: D, qty: t, eta: 0 });
    if (rem > 0) {
      var sp = own.avail - free;
      if (cfg.safetyFirst && sp >= rem) {
        var use = rem, fc = n(db.forecast(M, D));
        add({ step: 'Local Safety', from: D, qty: use, eta: 0 });
        refill = { at: D, qty: use + fc, eta: db.supplierLead(M, D), note: 'refill safety stock (' + use + ') + forecast ' + fc };
        say('Step 2 local safety stock (' + sp + ') completes the order: used ' + use + ', refill PO ' + refill.qty);
      } else say('Step 2 local safety stock ' + sp + ' cannot complete remaining ' + rem + ': not used');
    }
    if (rem > 0) {
      var oth = [];
      for (i = 0; i < wh.length; i++) {
        var L = wh[i]; if (L === D) continue;
        var s = db.stock(M, L), fr = Math.max(0, s.avail - s.safety), tr = transit(L, D);
        say('Step 3 ' + L + ': available ' + s.avail + ', safety ' + s.safety + ' (never used), importable ' + fr + ', transit ' + tr + 'd');
        if (fr > 0 && has(tr)) oth.push({ loc: L, free: fr, eta: tr });
      }
      oth.sort(byEta);
      for (i = 0; i < oth.length; i++) { t = take(oth[i].free); if (t > 0) add({ step: 'Transfer', from: oth[i].loc, qty: t, eta: oth[i].eta }); }
    }
    if (rem > 0) {
      var c = [], ol = db.supplierLead(M, D);
      if (has(ol)) c.push({ step: 'Supplier Direct', from: D, eta: ol });
      for (i = 0; i < wh.length; i++) {
        var W = wh[i]; if (W === D) continue;
        var sl = db.supplierLead(M, W), tw = transit(W, D);
        if (has(sl) && has(tw)) c.push({ step: 'Supplier via Warehouse', from: W, eta: sl + tw + cfg.transitBuffer, supplierEta: sl, transit: tw });
      }
      c.sort(function (a, b) { return (a.eta - b.eta) || (a.step === 'Supplier Direct' ? -1 : 1); });
      var best = c[0] || null;
      for (i = 0; i < c.length; i++) say('Step 4 route ' + c[i].step + ' via ' + c[i].from + ': arrives in ' + c[i].eta + 'd (need ' + need + 'd)');
      if (!best || best.eta > need) {
        var dn = [];
        for (i = 0; i < wh.length; i++) {
          var Q = wh[i]; if (Q === D) continue;
          var tq = transit(Q, D), sq = db.supplierLead(M, Q), rs = db.reservations(M, Q);
          for (j = 0; j < rs.length; j++) {
            var r = rs[j], why = null;
            if (r.inProduction) why = 'donor order already in production';
            else if (mat.critical && !cfg.allowCriticalPreempt) why = 'critical material';
            else if (r.priority - prio < cfg.priorityGap) why = 'our priority is not higher enough';
            else if (!has(tq) || tq > need) why = 'transfer too slow';
            else if (!has(sq) || sq + cfg.preemptBuffer > r.neededByDays) why = 'donor cannot rebuy in time (' + sq + 'd + buffer vs ' + r.neededByDays + 'd)';
            if (why) say('Step 5 preempt ' + Q + ' reservation ' + r.ref + ' refused: ' + why);
            else dn.push({ loc: Q, ref: r.ref, qty: r.qty, eta: tq, replEta: sq });
          }
        }
        dn.sort(byEta);
        for (i = 0; i < dn.length; i++) {
          t = take(dn[i].qty);
          if (t > 0) { add({ step: 'Preempt', from: dn[i].loc, qty: t, eta: dn[i].eta, ref: dn[i].ref, donorReplenish: { at: dn[i].loc, qty: t, eta: dn[i].replEta } }); say('Step 5 preempt ' + dn[i].loc + ' reservation ' + dn[i].ref + ': take ' + t + ', donor rebuys in ' + dn[i].replEta + 'd'); }
        }
      }
      if (rem > 0) {
        if (best) { var q = rem; add({ step: best.step, from: best.from, qty: q, eta: best.eta, supplierEta: best.supplierEta, transit: best.transit }); if (best.eta > need) say('Step 6 no route meets needed-by, best is late: planner task'); }
        else { failed = true; say('Step 6 no supplier route and no stock: FAILED, planner task'); }
      }
    }
    var late = false, pre = false, eta = 0, total = 0;
    for (i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) { late = late || lines[i].late; pre = pre || lines[i].step === 'Preempt'; eta = Math.max(eta, lines[i].eta); total += lines[i].cost; }
    var status = (failed || rem > 0) ? 'Failed' : late ? 'Late' : pre ? 'Needs Approval' : 'Ready';
    return { status: status, lines: lines, refill: refill, remaining: rem, eta: eta, cost: total, needsApproval: pre || late || failed || total > cfg.approvalValue, log: log };
  }
  function check(res, exp) {
    var e = [], i, s = [];
    for (i = 0; i < res.lines.length; i++) s.push(res.lines[i].step);
    if (exp.status && res.status !== exp.status) e.push('status ' + res.status + ' expected ' + exp.status);
    if (exp.steps && s.join(',') !== exp.steps.join(',')) e.push('steps [' + s.join(',') + '] expected [' + exp.steps.join(',') + ']');
    if (exp.qty) for (i = 0; i < exp.qty.length; i++) if (!res.lines[i] || res.lines[i].qty !== exp.qty[i]) e.push('line ' + i + ' qty ' + (res.lines[i] && res.lines[i].qty) + ' expected ' + exp.qty[i]);
    if (exp.from) for (i = 0; i < exp.from.length; i++) if (exp.from[i] && (!res.lines[i] || res.lines[i].from !== exp.from[i])) e.push('line ' + i + ' from ' + (res.lines[i] && res.lines[i].from) + ' expected ' + exp.from[i]);
    if (exp.refill && !res.refill) e.push('missing safety refill');
    if (exp.notFrom) for (i = 0; i < res.lines.length; i++) if (exp.notFrom.indexOf(res.lines[i].from) >= 0 && res.lines[i].step.indexOf('Supplier') < 0) e.push('used stock from forbidden ' + res.lines[i].from);
    return e;
  }
  return { plan: plan, check: check, DEFAULTS: DEFAULTS };
}

var SourcingEngine = Class.create();
SourcingEngine.prototype = {
  initialize: function (cfg) { this.cfg = cfg || __SC_CONFIG; this.core = __SC_factory(); this.P = 'x_2056099_indust_0_'; },
  /* p: {material:'RM-VAL-001', destination:'WH-BLR', qty:100, neededByDays:9, priority:1(High)|2|3(Low), dryRun:true} */
  plan: function (p) {
    var res = this.core.plan(this._db(), p, this.cfg.settings);
    if (!p.dryRun) res.applied = this._apply(res, p);
    return res;
  },
  check: function (res, exp) { return this.core.check(res, exp); },
  _gr: function (t) { return new GlideRecord(this.P + t); },
  _db: function () {
    var self = this, cfg = this.cfg;
    function dv(g, f) { return String(g.getDisplayValue(f) || '').toLowerCase(); }
    function days(d) { var a = new GlideDateTime(d), b = new GlideDateTime(); return Math.round((a.getNumericValue() - b.getNumericValue()) / 86400000); }
    return {
      material: function (id) { var g = self._gr('mat_master'); if (!g.get('material_product_id', id)) return null; return { critical: dv(g, 'criticality') === 'critical', cost: Number(g.getValue('standard_cost')) || 0, supplier: g.preferred_supplier.getDisplayValue(), safety: Number(g.getValue('safety_stock')) || 0 }; },
      locations: function () { var o = [], g = self._gr('inv_loc'); g.addQuery('location_id', 'STARTSWITH', 'WH-'); g.addActiveQuery(); g.query(); while (g.next()) o.push(g.getValue('location_id')); return o; },
      transfer: function (a, b) {
        if (a === b) return 0;
        if (!gs.tableExists(self.P + 'transfer_lead_time')) {
          var key = a + '>' + b;
          var defs = { 'WH-BLR>WH-HYD': 2, 'WH-HYD>WH-BLR': 2, 'WH-BLR>WH-MAA': 1, 'WH-MAA>WH-BLR': 1, 'WH-HYD>WH-MAA': 2, 'WH-MAA>WH-HYD': 2 };
          return defs[key] !== undefined ? defs[key] : 2;
        }
        var g = self._gr('transfer_lead_time'); g.addQuery('source_warehouse.location_id', a); g.addQuery('destination_warehouse.location_id', b); g.addQuery('active', true); g.setLimit(1); g.query(); return g.next() ? Number(g.getValue('lead_time_days')) : null;
      },
      supplierLead: function (mat, loc) { var m = this.material(mat); var s = m && cfg.supplierLeadDays[m.supplier]; return (s && s[loc] !== undefined) ? s[loc] : null; },
      stock: function (mat, loc) {
        var g = self._gr('inv_stock'), avail = 0, res = 0, tot = 0, now = new GlideDateTime();
        g.addQuery('material_product.material_product_id', mat); g.addQuery('location.location_id', loc); g.query();
        while (g.next()) {
          var t = Number(g.getValue('total_quantity')) || 0, r = Number(g.getValue('reserved_quantity')) || 0; tot += t; res += r;
          var q = '';
          try {
            if (g.batch_lot) q = String(g.batch_lot.quality_status.getDisplayValue() || g.batch_lot.quality_status || '').toLowerCase();
          } catch (e) {}
          var st = dv(g, 'status'), ex = g.getValue('expiry_date');
          var okSt = !st || (st.indexOf('quarantine') < 0 && st.indexOf('expired') < 0 && st.indexOf('block') < 0 && st.indexOf('reject') < 0);
          var isBadQ = q.indexOf('reject') >= 0 || q.indexOf('fail') >= 0 || q.indexOf('quarant') >= 0 || q.indexOf('pend') >= 0;
          var okQ = !isBadQ && (q.indexOf('approved') >= 0 || q.indexOf('pass') >= 0 || !q || q === 'null');
          if (okQ && okSt && (!ex || new GlideDateTime(ex + ' 00:00:00').getNumericValue() > now.getNumericValue())) avail += Math.max(0, t - r);
        }
        var m = this.material(mat); return { avail: avail, reserved: res, total: tot, safety: m ? m.safety : 0 };
      },
      reservations: function (mat, loc) {
        var o = [], g = self._gr('inv_req'); g.addQuery('material_product.material_product_id', mat); g.addQuery('source_location.location_id', loc); g.query();
        while (g.next()) {
          if (dv(g, 'request_type').indexOf('reserv') < 0 || dv(g, 'status').indexOf('approved') < 0) continue;
          var po = self._gr('production_order'), pr = 2, inProd = false, nb = 999, ref = g.getValue('related_production_order');
          if (ref && po.get('number', ref)) { var p = dv(po, 'priority'); pr = p === 'high' ? 1 : (p === 'low' ? 3 : 2); var s = dv(po, 'status'); inProd = s.indexOf('in production') >= 0 || s === 'qc'; if (po.getValue('planned_end_date')) nb = days(po.getValue('planned_end_date')); }
          o.push({ ref: ref, qty: Number(g.getValue('quantity_requested')) || 0, priority: pr, inProduction: inProd, neededByDays: nb });
        }
        return o;
      },
      forecast: function (mat, loc) {
        var g = self._gr('inv_txn'), q = 0, from = new GlideDateTime(); from.addDaysUTC(-90);
        g.addQuery('material_product.material_product_id', mat); g.addQuery('source_location.location_id', loc); g.addQuery('transaction_date', '>=', from); g.query();
        while (g.next()) { var t = dv(g, 'transaction_type'); if (t.indexOf('issue') >= 0 || t.indexOf('reserv') >= 0) q += Number(g.getValue('quantity')) || 0; }
        return Math.round(q / 3);
      }
    };
  },
  _setC: function (g, f, label) {
    var c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice'); c.addQuery('name', g.getTableName()); c.addQuery('element', f); c.addQuery('inactive', false); c.query();
    var want = String(label).toLowerCase();
    while (c.next()) { var l = String(c.getValue('label')).toLowerCase(); if (l === want || l.indexOf(want) >= 0) { g.setValue(f, c.getValue('value')); return true; } }
    return false;
  },
  _id: function (t, f, v) { var g = this._gr(t); return g.get(f, v) ? g.getUniqueValue() : null; },
  _alert: function (p, type, msg, qty) {
    var a = this._gr('inv_alert'); a.initialize(); this._setC(a, 'alert_type', type); this._setC(a, 'severity', 'High'); this._setC(a, 'status', 'Open');
    a.setValue('material_product', this._id('mat_master', 'material_product_id', p.material)); a.setValue('alert_message', '[SOURCING] ' + msg); a.setValue('current_quantity', qty || 0); return a.insert();
  },
  _apply: function (res, p) {
    var out = [], i, l, mat = this._id('mat_master', 'material_product_id', p.material), dest = this._id('inv_loc', 'location_id', p.destination);
    for (i = 0; i < res.lines.length; i++) {
      l = res.lines[i];
      if (l.step === 'Local Available' || l.step === 'Local Safety') {
        var need = l.qty, s = this._gr('inv_stock'); s.addQuery('material_product', mat); s.addQuery('location', dest); s.orderBy('expiry_date'); s.query();
        while (s.next() && need > 0) {
          var q = String(s.batch_lot.quality_status.getDisplayValue()).toLowerCase(); if (q.indexOf('approved') < 0) continue;
          var av = (Number(s.getValue('total_quantity')) || 0) - (Number(s.getValue('reserved_quantity')) || 0); if (av <= 0) continue;
          var t = Math.min(av, need); s.setValue('reserved_quantity', (Number(s.getValue('reserved_quantity')) || 0) + t); s.update(); need -= t;
        }
        var x = this._gr('inv_txn'); x.initialize(); this._setC(x, 'transaction_type', 'Reservation'); x.setValue('material_product', mat); x.setValue('quantity', l.qty); x.setValue('source_location', dest);
        x.setValue('reason', '[SOURCING] ' + l.step + ' reserved for ' + (p.orderRef || 'order')); out.push('reserved ' + l.qty + ' (' + l.step + ')' + (x.insert() ? '' : ' txn failed'));
      } else if (l.step === 'Transfer' || l.step === 'Preempt') {
        var r = this._gr('inv_req'); r.initialize(); this._setC(r, 'request_type', 'Transfer'); this._setC(r, 'status', 'Submitted'); this._setC(r, 'priority', p.priority === 1 ? 'High' : (p.priority === 3 ? 'Low' : 'Medium'));
        r.setValue('material_product', mat); r.setValue('quantity_requested', l.qty); r.setValue('source_location', this._id('inv_loc', 'location_id', l.from)); r.setValue('destination_location', dest);
        r.setValue('reason', '[SOURCING] ' + l.step + (l.ref ? ' of reservation ' + l.ref : '') + ' eta ' + l.eta + 'd'); out.push('transfer request ' + r.insert());
        if (l.step === 'Preempt') out.push('donor procurement alert ' + this._alert(p, 'Material Shortage', 'Donor ' + l.from + ' must rebuy ' + l.qty + ' within ' + l.donorReplenish.eta + 'd (preempted)', l.qty));
      } else if (l.step.indexOf('Supplier') === 0) {
        out.push('procurement alert ' + this._alert(p, 'Supplier', 'PO needed: ' + l.qty + ' via ' + l.from + ', arrives in ' + l.eta + 'd' + (l.late ? ' (LATE)' : ''), l.qty));
      }
    }
    if (res.refill) out.push('refill alert ' + this._alert(p, 'Material Shortage', 'Safety refill PO ' + res.refill.qty + ' at ' + res.refill.at, res.refill.qty));
    return out;
  },
  type: 'SourcingEngine'
};
]]></script>
